vars.name: AGB_AGY_BIN
vars.description: Path or name of the agy executable used for builds, quota telemetry, doctor checks and bootstrap.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_DIRTY
vars.description: Set to 1 to let agb run start against a repository with uncommitted changes (otherwise the run refuses to start).

vars.name: AGB_BUILD_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Per-ticket builder timeout passed to agy. For stream-json output, 0 (or empty) means no wall-clock limit; the ceiling and no-progress watchdog still apply.

vars.name: AGB_BUILD_MAX_TIMEOUT
vars.description: Hard ceiling on a single agy invocation, applied even when AGB_BUILD_TIMEOUT is 0.

vars.name: AGB_EVENT_PROGRESS_TIMEOUT
vars.description: No-progress watchdog: an agy stream that emits no events for this long is terminated.

vars.name: AGB_KILL_GRACE_MS
vars.description: Milliseconds to wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL when stopping an agy process tree.

vars.name: AGB_PROVIDER
vars.description: Only the value jetski is meaningful: bootstrap then installs plugins through the jetski runner. The MCP server sets it to jetski for the agb processes it spawns.

vars.name: AGB_SESSION_ID
vars.description: Fallback session id used to locate the active brain when ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID is unset; forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ANTIGRAVITY_CONVERSATION_ID
vars.description: Current Antigravity conversation id. Used to locate the active brain and artifact directory, and forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: AGB_TARGET_REPO
vars.description: Extra directory bin/node-launcher.sh searches when locating a project-local Node runtime.

vars.name: AGB_WORKER_MODE
vars.description: Set by agb on read-only worker agy processes (value readonly). The PreToolUse guard denies mutations and never prompts while it is set.

vars.name: AGB_WORKER_TICKET
vars.description: Set by agb on builder agy processes to the ticket id; the PreToolUse guard scopes writes to that ticket and never prompts.

vars.name: ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_NAME
vars.description: Not read from the environment: a source constant in lib/plugin-paths.mjs naming the companion plugin's directory under the agy plugins folder.

vars.name: ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_PATH
vars.description: Source checkout of the adlc-antigravity plugin to install from. Honoured by bootstrap only in unbundled runs and only together with AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN=1.

vars.name: AGB_DEV_ALLOW_UNVERIFIED_PLUGIN
vars.description: Set to 1 (unbundled runs only) to let bootstrap install an unverified companion plugin from ADLC_ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_PATH.

vars.name: AGB_PLUGIN_DIR
vars.description: Two readers: the companion-plugin handshake manifest directory (ignored by the bundled build) and the directory agb sidecar writes its plugin manifest into (honoured in every build).

vars.name: AGB_PLUGIN_ROOT
vars.description: Plugin root holding vendor/adlc, used to find the vendored adlc CLI. Unbundled runs only.

vars.name: ADLC_CLI_PATH
vars.description: Custom adlc executable. Honoured only with AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI=1 in unbundled runs; the bundled build uses only the vendored adlc.

vars.name: AGB_ADLC_BIN
vars.description: Alias of ADLC_CLI_PATH with the same restrictions (AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI=1, unbundled only).

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_CUSTOM_ADLC_CLI
vars.description: Set to 1 to honour ADLC_CLI_PATH / AGB_ADLC_BIN in unbundled runs. The path must pass the temporary/world-writable path checks.

vars.name: AGB_ALLOW_SYSTEM_ADLC
vars.description: Set to 1 to let unbundled runs fall back to an adlc found on the system PATH.

vars.name: ADLC_ADMIN_KEY
vars.description: HMAC key used to verify a Windows sandbox-bypass attestation. Treated as a secret: never forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ADLC_MANIFEST_KEY
vars.description: Key used by adlc gate-manifest. Treated as a secret: never forwarded to builder agy processes.

vars.name: ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT
vars.description: Set to 1 by the scheduler on builder processes when rail enforcement is available, enabling the PreToolUse rails hook.

vars.name: ADLC_PROVIDER
vars.description: Read by the @adlc tools, not by agb. Bootstrap suggests ADLC_PROVIDER=agy to run them on Antigravity quota.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKET
vars.description: Set by the scheduler on builder processes to the ticket id whose rails the PreToolUse hook enforces.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKETS
vars.description: Alternative ticket-store path the PreToolUse guard also protects.

vars.name: ADLC_TICKET_STORE
vars.description: Ticket-store path override the PreToolUse guard also protects.

vars.name: AGB_HOOK_DISABLE
vars.description: Any non-empty value bypasses the PreToolUse rails guard. Each bypass is logged to hooks.log and agb doctor warns about it.

vars.name: AGB_REQUIRE_DRIVER_SIGNATURE
vars.description: Set to 1 to make the Windows doctor sandbox check require a signed driver attestation in the probe output.

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_GATES
vars.description: Set to 0 to run gate commands without the OS sandbox (an explicit acknowledgement of host risk).

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_PROBE_CMD
vars.description: Doctor sandbox-probe command override. Restricted to test execution; otherwise the check fails.

vars.name: AGB_SANDBOX_PROBE_HELPER
vars.description: Helper script passed to the doctor sandbox probe. Honoured only during test execution.

vars.name: AGB_STRICT_GATES
vars.default: on in plan; off in run unless the repo has package.json
vars.description: Plan compilation uses strict gates unless set to 0. At run time, 1 forces gate commands to match the npm pattern even without a package.json.

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_DIR
vars.description: Directory for the shared pool state, v2 state and lock files.

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_LOCK
vars.description: Explicit pool lock file path (otherwise derived from AGB_POOLS_DIR or AGB_QUOTA_STATE).

vars.name: AGB_POOLS_V2
vars.description: Explicit v2 pool state file path (otherwise derived from AGB_POOLS_DIR or AGB_QUOTA_STATE).

vars.name: AGB_QUOTA_STATE
vars.description: Explicit shared quota state file path; the v2 and lock paths are derived from it when not set.

vars.name: AGB_QUOTA_TIMEOUT_MS
vars.description: Maximum milliseconds a ticket waits for a quota reset before failing.

vars.name: AGB_SIDECAR_PORT
vars.description: Default port for agb sidecar; --port overrides it.

vars.name: ANTIGRAVITY_SIDECAR_WEB_PORT
vars.description: Selects jetski mode in the sidecar launcher and sets its port.
vars.security: Setting it disables token auth on the sidecar dashboard and event stream: any local client can read run data.

vars.name: AGB_ARTIFACT_DIR
vars.description: Where agb writes plan artifacts.

vars.name: AGB_BRAIN_DIR
vars.description: Antigravity brain directory searched for plans.

vars.name: AGB_CALIBRATION_DIR
vars.description: Where agb probe appends its probe-<day>.md calibration file.

vars.name: AGB_EXEC_CACHE_DIR
vars.description: Cache directory for authenticated executables.

vars.name: AGB_EXEC_LOCKS_DIR
vars.description: Directory for executable lock records; stale locks with a dead PID are recovered.

vars.name: AGB_HOME_DIR
vars.description: Home directory override for agb's per-user state.

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_CONTAINMENT_MECHANISM
vars.description: Test double for kernel containment detection.

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_CONTAINMENT_UNAVAILABLE
vars.description: Test double: report kernel containment unavailable.

vars.name: AGB_MOCK_WIN_CANARY
vars.description: Test double for the Windows sandbox canary path.
